latestVersion.changelog: Initial release. Adds a Windows-friendly Chrome CDP operator for attaching an AI agent to an existing Chrome profile, validating live browser attachment, driving mouse and keyboard input with human-like behavior, running guarded X search and draft workflows, and using optional notification hooks without shipping any personal defaults.
